attempts.summary: Bridged node1's eth1/eth2 (previously two isolated segments to node2 and node3) into a single br0 with STP off and no IP address, making node1 a pure L2 forwarder. Assigned node2's enp8s0 and node3's enp8s0 static addresses 192.168.50.11/24 and 192.168.50.12/24 (persisted via systemd-networkd drop-ins), so the two hosts now share one subnet and reach each other directly with node1 switching frames instead of routing. Completed the mandatory one-node-at-a-time restart protocol on all three nodes: captured boot-identity baselines, restarted each, confirmed changed boot IDs, and verified post-restart recovery (node1's non-persistent bridge was rebuilt after its own reboot and connectivity re-verified end to end).
